newsitem.title: USA: United Air, attendants to intensify talks.
newsitem.headline: United Air, attendants to intensify talks.

text.p: United Airlines and the Association of Flight Attendants said Friday they will pick up the pace of contract negotations next month.

Both sides recently expressed dissatisfaciton with the pace of contract talks, which are focusing on raises, retirement and respect, according to the union that represents 21,000 United flight attendants.
The union said its contract with the UAL Corp subsidiary became amendable on March 1, 1996 and talks began last year.
The two sides plan to move the negotiations out of the Chicago area to limit the distractions the negotiators face from the press of day-to-day business, the union said.
The site of the negotiations will not be disclosed.
Earlier this week, United reached tentative agreements with its union pilots and mechanics on wage and benefit increases.
UAL shares closed up 2-1/4 Friday at 66-3/4.
